cover_letter:
Dear Qargo team,

I'm writing to apply for the Regional Marketing Specialist position. Qargo's mission to help logistics operations run more efficiently through an all-in-one SaaS platform resonates with me, and I'm excited about the opportunity to own regional marketing for the Netherlands and potentially expand into other markets like DACH.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I've gained hands-on experience in B2B marketing across multiple channels. I've built and optimized websites for both traditional and AI-powered search, written SEO content that ranks, and used tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs and Google Ads to track performance and refine campaigns. I've also managed CMS platforms including WordPress and Shopify, and collaborated with clients and team members to deliver projects on time. My technical background in computer science and front-end development allows me to work comfortably with data, reporting and marketing technologies.

I'm particularly drawn to this role because it combines creative content work with analytical campaign execution. I enjoy turning strategy into local campaigns that resonate with the target audience, and I'm proactive in coordinating with stakeholders and agencies to ensure high-quality delivery. While my Dutch is currently at a writing B1 and speaking A2+ level, I'm fluent in English and confident in my ability to adapt to new markets. I'm eager to learn and grow with Qargo, and I'm excited about the prospect of contributing to your expansion into new regions.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my skills and enthusiasm can support Qargo's marketing goals.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
